description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Own the technical build and delivery of a tailored AI solution for a large client, from design through live rollout. Work daily with a distributed engineering group and serve as a technical point of contact for the client's engineers.
 What you'll do
 - Adapt a core AI platform to a large client's environment, owning the work from design through rollout.
 - Collaborate daily with a remote engineering team to bring client-specific changes back into the shared codebase.
 - Own production releases, integrations and reliability of AI systems in a regulated setting.
 - Act as the main technical contact for the client's engineers, with roughly 20% of time spent in client-facing work.
 - Diagnose complex production issues and drive them to resolution with little oversight.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 6 to 12 years of software engineering experience.
 - Solid Python development background on backend or full-stack work, delivering features powered by machine learning from start to finish.
 - Track record of releasing LLM-based or agent-style systems that real outside users depend on in live environments.
 - Recent experience as an engineer at a high-growth startup delivering software to business customers.
 - Strong skills in software architecture and system design, with the ability to carry technical delivery from start to finish.
 - Based on the US East Coast and available during Eastern time hours.
 - BS in Computer Science or a related field.
 Bonus points
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms, Kubernetes, CI/CD and observability tooling, without needing a pure infrastructure profile.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 200,000 to 350,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - Remote (US)
 - Full-time
